heading: Buildings to be planned for use by persons with a disability
content:
72.
Buildings to be planned for use by persons with a disability
(1)
Subject to paragraphs (3) and (4) and notwithstanding any other provisions
(other than the provisions under this
regulation and
regulation 73) in these regulations, where a
building is one to which persons with a disability have, or may reasonably be
expected to have, access, that building shall be designed to the satisfaction of the
Building Authority in such a manner as will facilitate the access to, and use of,
that building and its facilities by persons with a disability.
(L.N. 239 of
1997; L.N. 52 of
2026)
(2)
A building shall be deemed to be designed in accordance with paragraph (1) if its design complies with the requirements set out in Part 2 of the Third Schedule.
(L.N. 124 of 2008)
(3)
The provisions of this regulation shall apply to the categories of buildings specified in the first column of Part 4 of the Third Schedule only to the extent specified in the second column thereof.
(L.N. 124 of 2008)
(4)
The provisions of this regulation shall not apply to—
(a)
a single-household building of 13 m or less in height above ground level;
or
(L.N. 52 of
2026)
(b)
temporary buildings or contractor’s sheds referred to in Part VII.
(L.N. 239
of 1997)
(L.N. 365 of 1984)
